newsitem.title: USA: Invacare will not raise Healthdyne bid.
newsitem.headline: Invacare will not raise Healthdyne bid.

text.p: Invacare Corp chief executive Malachi Mixon said the company will not raise its $200 million hostile offer for Healthdyne Technologies Inc, leaving Healthdyne shareholders to decide the fate of the offer.
"At this point, we're waiting for the shareholders' meeting and will let the shareholders decide. There's nothing we intend to do," Mixon told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Earlier Wednesday, Healthdyne rejected Invacare's latest offer of $15 per share. Invacare has raised its bid three times since launching the takeover in January.
Healthdyne shareholders are slated to vote on the offer at the company's annual meeting on July 30.
